hook.text: It's a year from now. Your project has failed spectacularly. Now write the story of why. That's a premortem.

buildup.text: Gary Klein's premortem reverses optimism bias by assuming failure has already happened before you begin.

discovery.text: Prospective hindsight increases the ability to identify reasons for outcomes by 30%, research shows.

twist.text: It gives team members permission to voice doubts. In postmortems, lessons come too late to help.

climax.text: By imagining failure first, you build better safeguards before any damage is done.

punchline.text: Imagine the failure now. Prevent it before it starts.

quiz.question: What is a premortem analysis?
options: Imagining a project failed and analyzing why before it starts
